story.en: Following the failure of his honey trap, Zhou Yu hatches another scheme, determined to seize Jiangling—

trigger.zh: 江陵属刘备，柴桑属孙权。诸葛亮、刘备、赵云、张飞、周瑜、孙权、鲁肃存活且属于正确势力。庞统在野且主角不为庞统。周瑜没有在剧情【甘露惊澜】中完成逆天改命。曹操、刘璋势力存在。
trigger.en: Jiangling belongs to Liu Bei, and Chaisang belongs to Sun Quan. Zhuge Liang, Liu Bei, Zhao Yun, Zhang Fei, Zhou Yu, Sun Quan, and Lu Su are alive and belong to their respective factions. Pang Tong is Free and the protagonist is not Pang Tong. Zhou Yu did not achieve Defy Fate in the event 【Turmoil at Ganlu】. The Cao Cao and Liu Zhang factions exist.
